itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter12_verse5.title: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 12 Verse 5
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter12_verse5.introduction: This verse belongs to Chapter 12 of the Bhagavad Gita.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter12_verse5.scripture_text: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 12, Verse 5 teaches disciplined action, inner clarity, and devotion to the Divine as a path to liberation.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter12_verse5.philosophical_explanation: This verse contributes to Krishna's teaching on dharma, yoga, and liberation.
